---
name: Rule not supported
about: A planning rule from your jurisdiction that a rulebook cannot express
labels: rules
---

**Jurisdiction and plan** (name, version or date)

**The rule** (quote the text and give the rule number; link the plan)

**How it is measured** (from which line or level, in which direction, with
what exemptions; a diagram helps)

**Which zones or areas it applies to**

**How much it matters** (roughly how many sites, and whether leaving it out
overstates or understates capacity)
